sections.title: From character lookup to bitmap
sections.prose: The public load_char path turns a character code into a glyph index with get_char_index, then sends that index and the same load flags through load_glyph; callers can also start directly at load_glyph. The rendering entry render_char_mode_for_index_with_native_hint_mode first scales and loads the outline; if it is empty in LCD mode, the function returns render_empty_loaded_outline immediately. When the outline is nonempty and the selected mode is Normal, render_char_mode_for_index_with_native_hint_mode passes the scaled outline to render_scaled_normal, entering the normal-mode bitmap route.

sections.title: Opening bytes and parsing an SFNT face
sections.prose: Library::new_memory_face accepts borrowed font bytes, delegates opening to Font::memory_face, and returns a Face or propagates the opening error. The face index and point size travel into that parser. memory_face checks format-specific probes, including type1_face, before falling back to truetype_face. If that fails on at least 118 bytes, winfnt_face gets a final chance; only an UnknownFileFormat paired with has_winfnt_header_shape replaces the original TrueType error. For SFNT/TTC input, truetype_face_with_load_mode_and_design_coords uses resolve_face_index and parse_table_directory_at; parse_head is required, so a missing head table fails face creation. By contrast, parse_maxp and parse_cmap failures are converted to default tables, allowing construction to continue with fallback metadata rather than rejecting every malformed optional parse.

sections.title: Glyph loading: bypasses, bitmaps and hint choices
sections.prose: normalize_load_flags forces NO_SCALE when either ppem is zero or NO_RECURSE is set; NO_SCALE in turn adds NO_HINTING and NO_BITMAP and clears RENDER. BITMAP_METRICS_ONLY also clears RENDER, so a request that looks render-capable may deliberately stop before bitmap creation. Before ordinary outline loading, sbix_missing_bitmap_glyph may return the empty_sbit_glyph_slot fallback. If svg_allowed, an available SVG returns a document, while svg_only errors when it is absent; if sbit_allowed, load_sbit_only_glyph returns an embedded bitmap on success, but a failed attempt errors only when sbits_only is set and otherwise falls through. After those earlier routes, NO_RECURSE, NO_SCALE, and NO_HINTING select progressively different loaders; FORCE_AUTOHINT is used only when NO_AUTOHINT is absent. TARGET_LIGHT is another auto-hint route, while glyph_slot_load_default_with_layout_and_mode_and_hdmx_and_pedantic receives native_hint_mode and pedantic-hinting state.
